values.note: Reservable online: Turkey Ridge 12-15 and Deer Run 19-22, 51-53, April 15 to the second Friday of October; the reservation minimum (4 nights, 7 on holidays) applies to those seven sites only. Every other site is first come, first served. Check-in after 4 PM, check-out before 3 PM. No refunds on cancellation.

note: Sioux County Conservation park 7 mi N of Hawarden on the Big Sioux River, with two campgrounds about 1 km apart: Turkey Ridge near the entrance and the larger Deer Run in the river bottom. Both are concrete pads in the woods, set back from the river, which is reached from the boat ramp. --Claude
summary: Mycountyparks pages confirm $22-27 (electric $22, full $26, reservable $27; tent $17), 50A with water/sewer at select Deer Run sites, 57 RV sites (39 Deer Run + 18 Turkey Ridge) plus 10 tent, showers/flush/dump, mid-April to mid-October, 7 reservable sites (4-night minimum, 7 on holidays) with the rest FCFS, 14-day limit; not waterfront stands; pin is the park entrance on Cherry Ave, 0.65-1.7 km from the campgrounds.
flags: PIN: stored 43.06230,-96.45100 is the park entrance on Cherry Ave, about 650 m E of Turkey Ridge (43.0620,-96.4588, 18 sites) and about 1.7 km E of Deer Run (39 sites, loop centroid ~43.0585,-96.4715 on NAIP; Google 43.0582,-96.4692). Suggest moving to Deer Run, 43.0585,-96.4715.

WATERFRONT: 'not waterfront' confirmed. On NAIP the Big Sioux runs about 400 m N of Turkey Ridge and about 450 m N of Deer Run, both through unbroken forest; the small pond SW of Deer Run (~43.0570,-96.4775) is 250 m+ away across grass and trails.

MINIMUM STAY: the 7 reservable sites carry a standing 4-night minimum (7 on holidays), but every other site is first come with no minimum stated, so a one-night stay is still possible. Recorded, no inclusion concern.
SPLIT: Turkey Ridge and Deer Run are about 1.1 km apart but share the one park entrance and road, so no split.

SEASON CONFLICT: the Turkey Ridge page says 'Camping is available year round' (water off in winter) while the park page and Deer Run page say closed mid October to mid April. Recorded mid April to mid October with the conflict in season.note.
PHONE: 712-552-1047 confirmed (site pages 'For further questions please call: 712-552-1047'; Google).
